name: Create Moon Phases Diagram Lesson
description:
An 8th grade earth science teacher needs a lesson on the lunar cycle. Create a 4-page ActivInspire flipchart with the following structure:

Page 1 — Title Page: Title 'Moon Phases' and text mentioning the cycle takes approximately '29.5 days' (or '29 days').

Page 2 — Phase Diagram: Create a visual diagram using shapes (circles/ellipses) and text labels for all 8 phases: New Moon, Waxing Crescent, First Quarter, Waxing Gibbous, Full Moon, Waning Gibbous, Third Quarter, Waning Crescent.

Page 3 — Explanation: Title 'Why' or 'Explanation' and text explaining the process (must mention both 'Sun' and 'Earth').

Page 4 — Student Activity: Title 'Activity' or 'Challenge' with instructions for students to 'order' or 'sequence' the phases.

Save the flipchart to '/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/moon_phases_lesson.flipchart'.
